title: Stadium tour with Perry Como
summary: A Pullman-car show with Nat and Perry Como played five stadiums before 35,000-40,000 people.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: So I made -- then Nat went out with another show; we took a big show out with Pullman cars -- it was Nat Cole and Perry Como, and Perry was big on television then. And on that show it was Perry Como and Nat Cole, Roy Hamilton, Ralph Marterie band, Peg Leg Bates, Sarah Vaughn, and a cast of thousands, I guess you could say. We only played 5 cities; we played Briggs Stadium in Detroit, we played the stadiums, you know -- Soldier's Field, the Polo Grounds in New York, and the Muni Movie Stadium in Cleveland; you know, we were drawing like 35 and 40,000 -- and during that time, that was really something. It's not like the rock concerts, now, you know, they do that -- but at that time, it was -- they were both

superstars, and they both had their followings, but I guess that Perry may have had more of a following at the time because of the exposure he got on television. But I don't think anyone sold any more records than Nat. You know, he was a record seller.
